messages:
Maya (CS): Hi all — planning an interactive enablement lab for three pilot customers next Tue/Wed. Goal: hands-on migration from test to dedicated, demo of routing/fallback, and a short feedback capture at the end. Need ops/eng/support coverage. Proposed slots (please react with :one:/:two:/:three: or reply):

- Option 1: Tue 10:00–11:30 PT / 18:00–19:30 CET
- Option 2: Wed 08:00–09:30 PT / 16:00–17:30 CET
- Option 3: Wed 15:00–16:30 PT / 23:00–00:30 CET (APAC-friendly)

Ask list:
• Dedicated GPU quota for demo (1x A10s)
• Zoom host + breakout rooms (2 breakouts)
• Preloaded demo dataset + test API keys for customers
• Recording permission + short survey link at end

Liam (CSM): Option 1 works best for all three customers I talked to. I can run the agenda and the survey.

Omar (Solutions): I can be eng lead. Need reservation for GPU from 09:30–12:00 PT for warmup and teardown. Also will run through the migration checklist.

Nora (Support): I can cover onboarding Q&A for Options 1 and 2, but I’m out Wed afternoon (Option 3 no-go). I’ll prepare a 5-min common-issues doc.

Kai (EngOps): I’ll reserve the GPU and create a test pool with a demo token. Anyone confirm we should use dedicated pool or burst on shared? Dedicated for the demo is safer.

Maya (CS): Prefer dedicated. Also: customers will upload small datasets during the session — we need an upload bucket and a short S3 pre-signed link flow. Can we have a short runbook snippet for customers?

Kai (EngOps): I’ll add an S3 presign flow and provide sample commands. Example I’ll share in thread.

Omar (Solutions): Can we include a tiny smoke-test snippet for attendees to run before the session? Suggest putting it in the pre-read.

Liam (CSM): I’ll draft pre-read + survey and ping you for review. Also: permission to record? All three customers said yes, but they want the recording obfuscated for logs.

Maya (CS): Recording OK as long as logs are scrubbed. Liam — add a consent checkbox. Nora — pls add support note on what to redact.

Kai (EngOps): Presign + smoke test (example):
```bash
# Smoke test to validate connectivity to demo endpoint
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer DEMO_TOKEN' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}'
```
(Will provide DEMO_TOKEN for each attendee and rotate after session)

Omar (Solutions): Perfect. I’ll prep the migration checklist. Quick note: allow 10 extra minutes for KV-cache warmup.

calendar-bot: Draft event created: "Pilot enablement lab — customers A/B/C" with proposed slots. Link: https://calendar.example/evt/abc123

Liam (CSM): I voted :one: on the draft event and added customer emails. I’ll send pre-read by EOD Friday.

Maya (CS): Decisions for now: go with Option 1 (Tue 10:00 PT). Kai reserve GPU 09:30–12:00 PT and upload buckets + presign. Omar eng lead, Nora support. Liam will do pre-read and survey. Recording allowed with redaction.

Nora (Support): I’ll post the 5-min common-issues note and redact checklist into the event description.

Maya (CS): Thanks everyone — I’ll send the final invite once calendar-bot confirms. Final ask: please add any blockers before EOD today.

Kai (EngOps): No blockers from infra. I’ll update thread with the presign command and demo tokens once ready.

Omar (Solutions): Adding one thing — bring quick fallback demo to smaller model in case dedicated GPU flaps. I’ll prepare a 2-min fallback script.

Liam (CSM): Noted. I’ll include fallback note in pre-read.

Maya (CS): Awesome. Closing on Option 1. Thanks. :tada:
